item.title: Scraping Power BI page using RSelenium
item.description:
Hi, everyone
I am trying to scrap the following Power BI page: [https://app.powerbi.com/view?r=eyJrIjoiMmUxZjAzNGItN2VjZi00NWZmLTk3YTMtNzJmMjMwMTNhNGM0IiwidCI6IjhmMGQ0NTJjLWI3YTQtNDk2NC1iODEwLThjMzk3Mzc0NDc3YiIsImMiOjh9](https://app.powerbi.com/view?r=eyJrIjoiMmUxZjAzNGItN2VjZi00NWZmLTk3YTMtNzJmMjMwMTNhNGM0IiwidCI6IjhmMGQ0NTJjLWI3YTQtNDk2NC1iODEwLThjMzk3Mzc0NDc3YiIsImMiOjh9)
I am using Chrome, through RSelenium, since I wasn't able to scrap the queries in the site. So far, I could extract the text from the page, however I needed to select the tables (in the option 'Tabla') to obtain the proper data, which I couldn't do so far. Any idea on how to do it?
This is my code so far:
for (i in 1:30) { elements <- remDr$findElements(using = "xpath", value = "//*[contains(@class, 'visual-container')]") if (length(elements) > 0) break Sys.sleep(1) }
texts <- sapply(elements, function(el) el$getElementText()) cat(paste(texts, collapse = "\n\n---\n\n"))
remDr$close()
